questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of देवस्य.
questions.explanation: देवस्य ends in -स्य, the षष्ठी (genitive) singular ending of अकारान्त पुल्लिङ्ग nouns. It answers the question कस्य? (whose?).

questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of विद्यालये.
questions.explanation: विद्यालये ends in -े, the सप्तमी (locative) singular ending. It answers कुत्र? (where?).

questions.question: Which option best expresses the meaning of रामाय?
questions.explanation: रामाय is चतुर्थी एकवचन and answers कस्मै?, meaning 'to' or 'for Rama'.

questions.question:
बालकः विद्यालये पठति।

Which word is in सप्तमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: विद्यालये is सप्तमी because it indicates location ('in the school').

questions.question: Which question word correctly identifies गुरुणा?
questions.explanation: गुरुणा is तृतीया एकवचन and answers the question केन? (by whom? with whom?).

questions.question: Which word is NOT in पञ्चमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: The first three are पञ्चमी एकवचन ('from'). रामाय is चतुर्थी ('to/for Rama').

questions.question:
रामः मित्राय पुस्तकम् ददाति।

Which word is in चतुर्थी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: मित्राय is चतुर्थी because it indicates the recipient ('to the friend').

questions.question: Which word answers the question कस्य?
questions.explanation: रामस्य is षष्ठी विभक्ति and answers 'whose?'.

questions.question:
शिष्यः ग्रन्थात् श्लोकं पठति।

Which word is in पञ्चमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: ग्रन्थात् is पञ्चमी and expresses source ('from the book').

questions.question: Which pair has the same विभक्ति and वचन?
questions.explanation: Both रामस्य and देवस्य are षष्ठी एकवचन forms. The other pairs belong to different cases.

questions.question:
गुरुः शिष्याय ग्रन्थं ददाति।

Which word is in चतुर्थी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: शिष्याय is चतुर्थी एकवचन because it indicates the recipient ('to the student').

questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of देवेन.
questions.explanation: देवेन ends in -ेन, indicating तृतीया एकवचन (instrumental singular).

questions.question: Which is the best meaning of वने?
questions.explanation: वने is सप्तमी एकवचन and expresses location: 'in the forest'.

questions.question: Which question correctly identifies ग्रामात्?
questions.explanation: पञ्चमी विभक्ति answers कस्मात्? (from whom/from what?).

questions.question:
बालकः उद्याने क्रीडति।

Which word answers कुत्र?
questions.explanation: उद्याने is सप्तमी and answers the question 'Where?'.

questions.question: Which word is NOT in षष्ठी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: रामाय is चतुर्थी. The other three are possessive (genitive) forms.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence.

बालकः _____ गच्छति।

(to the village)
questions.explanation: Movement toward a destination uses चतुर्थी in the grammar covered by your course. Therefore ग्रामाय is the expected answer.

questions.question:
रामः मित्रेण सह विद्यालयं गच्छति।

Which word is in तृतीया विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: मित्रेण is तृतीया and is used with सह ('with a friend').

questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of पुस्तकस्य.
questions.explanation: पुस्तकस्य ends in -स्य, indicating षष्ठी एकवचन ('of the book').

questions.question:
शिष्यः गुरवे नमति।

Which word answers the question कस्मै?
questions.explanation: गुरवे is the dative (चतुर्थी) form of गुरु and answers कस्मै? ('to whom?').

questions.question:
रामः वृक्षात् फलम् आनयति।

Which word is in पञ्चमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: वृक्षात् is पञ्चमी एकवचन and answers कस्मात्? ('from where?').

questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of शिष्येण.
questions.explanation: The ending -ेण indicates तृतीया एकवचन.

questions.question: What is the best meaning of देवेन?
questions.explanation: देवेन is तृतीया एकवचन and commonly means 'by the god' or 'with the god'.

questions.question: Which question identifies आश्रमे?
questions.explanation: आश्रमे is सप्तमी and answers the question कुत्र?

questions.question:
मुनिः आश्रमे वसति।

Which word is in सप्तमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: आश्रमे indicates location and is therefore सप्तमी.

questions.question: Which word does NOT answer केन?
questions.explanation: रामस्य answers कस्य? (whose?), not केन?

questions.question:
शिष्यः गुरोः वचनं शृणोति।

Which word is in षष्ठी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: गुरोः is षष्ठी एकवचन of गुरु and answers कस्य?

questions.question: Which pair belongs to the same विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: Both रामेण and देवेन are तृतीया एकवचन forms.

questions.question:
बालकः आम्रात् फलम् गृह्णाति।

Which word expresses the source?
questions.explanation: आम्रात् is पञ्चमी and expresses 'from the mango tree'.

questions.question: Which word answers कस्य?
questions.explanation: ग्रन्थस्य is षष्ठी and answers 'whose?' or 'of what?'.

questions.question:
गुरुः शिष्येण सह आश्रमे वसति।

Which word is in तृतीया विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: शिष्येण is तृतीया एकवचन and is used with सह ('with the student').

questions.question:
बालकः वृक्षस्य समीपे तिष्ठति।

Which word is in षष्ठी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: वृक्षस्य is षष्ठी एकवचन and answers कस्य?

questions.question: Identify the विभक्ति and वचन of परिश्रमेण.
questions.explanation: The ending -ेण identifies तृतीया एकवचन. The ण appears because of the णत्व rule.

questions.question: Which is the best meaning of मोक्षाय?
questions.explanation: मोक्षाय is चतुर्थी एकवचन and expresses purpose or recipient: 'for liberation'.

questions.question: Which question identifies परिश्रमेण?
questions.explanation: तृतीया विभक्ति answers the question केन?

questions.question: Which word does NOT answer कुत्र?
questions.explanation: ग्रामात् is पञ्चमी ('from the village'). The other three are सप्तमी forms answering 'Where?'.

questions.question:
मुनिः ग्रन्थात् श्लोकं पठति।

Which word answers कस्मात्?
questions.explanation: ग्रन्थात् is पञ्चमी and answers 'From what?'.

questions.question:
रामः मित्राय फलं ददाति।

Which word indicates the recipient of the action?
questions.explanation: The recipient receives something. मित्राय is चतुर्थी and indicates 'to the friend'.

questions.question:
रामः मित्रेण सह ग्रामं गच्छति।

Which word answers केन?
questions.explanation: मित्रेण is in तृतीया विभक्ति and answers the question केन?

questions.question:
हे गुरो! शिष्यः कण्ठेन श्लोकं पठति।

Which word is in सम्बोधन विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: हे गुरो! is सम्बोधन (vocative), used when directly addressing someone.

questions.question:
बालकः वृक्षात् फलम् आनयति।

Which word answers किम्?
questions.explanation: Ask 'What does the boy bring?' The answer is फलम्, which is the कर्म (द्वितीया).

questions.question:
बालकः वृक्षात् फलम् आनयति।

Which word answers कस्मात्?
questions.explanation: वृक्षात् is पञ्चमी and indicates the source ('from the tree').

questions.question:
बालकः वृक्षात् फलम् आनयति।

Which word is in द्वितीया विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: फलम् is the object of the verb and is therefore in द्वितीया.

questions.question:
रामः आश्रमे श्लोकं पठति।

Which word answers कुत्र?
questions.explanation: आश्रमे is सप्तमी and answers 'Where?'.

questions.question:
रामः आश्रमे श्लोकं पठति।

Which word is the कर्म?
questions.explanation: श्लोकम् is what is being read, making it the कर्म.

questions.question:
रामः आश्रमे श्लोकं पठति।

Which word is in प्रथमा विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: रामः is the subject (कर्ता) and is therefore in प्रथमा.

questions.question: Which pair answers कुत्र?
questions.explanation: Both words are सप्तमी forms expressing location.

questions.question: Which pair answers कस्मात्?
questions.explanation: Both words are पञ्चमी forms expressing source.

questions.question:
शिष्यः ______ श्लोकं पठति।

Choose the word meaning 'in the hermitage'.
questions.explanation: आश्रमे is सप्तमी and means 'in the hermitage'.

questions.question: Which word does NOT answer कस्य?
questions.explanation: देवेन is तृतीया, not षष्ठी.

questions.question:
हे राम! बालकः विद्यालये ग्रन्थं पठति।

Which word is in सम्बोधन विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: हे राम! is सम्बोधन because Rama is being directly addressed.

questions.question:
हे राम! बालकः विद्यालये ग्रन्थं पठति।

Which word answers कुत्र?
questions.explanation: विद्यालये is सप्तमी indicating location.

questions.question:
हे राम! बालकः विद्यालये ग्रन्थं पठति।

Which word is the कर्म?
questions.explanation: ग्रन्थम् is what is being read.

questions.question: Which word is in तृतीया विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: रामेण is तृतीया एकवचन.

questions.question: Which word is in चतुर्थी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: मोक्षाय is चतुर्थी and expresses purpose or recipient.

questions.question: Which word is in पञ्चमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: ग्रामात् is पञ्चमी and answers 'from where?'.

questions.question: Which word is in सप्तमी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: आश्रमे is सप्तमी and answers 'where?'.

questions.question: Which group contains only तृतीया forms?
questions.explanation: All three words end in the instrumental singular ending.

questions.question: Which group contains only षष्ठी forms?
questions.explanation: Each word answers कस्य?

हे यज्ञेश! प्रातःकाले मुनिवरस्य आश्रमे शिष्यः मोक्षाय कण्ठेन ग्रन्थात् श्लोकं रटति।

Which word is in चतुर्थी विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: मोक्षाय is चतुर्थी and expresses purpose ('for liberation').
